How to Renew Your ITIN: Step-by-Step Guide

itin.so TeamApril 1, 20266 min read

When Do ITINs Expire?

ITINs expire if not used on a federal tax return for three consecutive years. The IRS also deactivates ITINs issued before 2013 on a rolling basis.

How to Know If Your ITIN Expired

The IRS sends Notice CP48 when your ITIN is scheduled to expire. You can also check by attempting to file a tax return.

Renewal Process

The renewal process is similar to the original application:

1. Complete Form W-7

2. Check the "Renewal" box

3. Include your current ITIN

4. Attach identity documents

5. Submit to IRS or through a CAA

Documents Needed for Renewal

You must provide current, unexpired identity documents. If your passport has expired since your original application, you need a new one.

Timeline

ITIN renewal follows the same 6-11 week processing timeline as new applications.
